title: Why Electric Bikes are More Dangerous than Motorcycles
summary: FortNine argues that e-bikes have injury rates and speeds closer to motorcycles than to pedal bikes. It argues riders should treat them with similar safety gear and caution.
why: Cited repeatedly in e-bike threads as a well-argued safety counterpoint from someone who rides both.

quote.text: Fortnine made an excellent argument against the safety of ebikes, worth watching as a rebuttal to this article
